title: DataMimic
summary: A full-stack TypeScript web app (Express API + React client) that uploads CSV datasets and generates synthetic data with privacy/utility evaluation metrics, using a Python engine when available and a JS fallback otherwise. The Python generator script directly imports and calls SDV's single-table synthesizers (CTGAN, GaussianCopula, TVAE, CopulaGAN), metadata schema, constraints, and evaluate_quality/evaluate_privacy functions to produce and score the synthetic data.
evidence: python_scripts/generate_synthetic.py:21-40 imports sdv.single_table synthesizers, metadata, constraints, and evaluate_quality/evaluate_privacy; used to generate and score synthetic CSVs
